description: This file contains Redux reducer functions for managing cloud-related state in a Mattermost application, including subscription, customer, products, invoices, limits, and error states.

classes.name: LimitsReducer
classes.description: Interface defining the shape of limits state, including limits data and load status.

classes.name: ErrorsReducer
classes.description: Interface defining the shape of error state, tracking failure states for various cloud data fetches.

methods.name: subscription
methods.description: Reducer handling cloud subscription state updates based on received actions.

methods.name: customer
methods.description: Reducer handling cloud customer data updates.

methods.name: products
methods.description: Reducer managing cloud products data, updating state with new product list.

methods.name: invoices
methods.description: Reducer managing cloud invoices data, updating state with invoice list.

methods.name: limits
methods.description: Reducer managing cloud limits data and load status, resetting on subscription receipt.

methods.name: errors
methods.description: Reducer tracking error states for cloud data fetch failures and resetting on successful data receipt.
